svg.title: Social Analytics Tool. One analytics API over MongoDB for documents, Cassandra for time series logs, Dgraph for relationships and ChromaDB with an LLM for semantic search.
svg.text: One analytics API on top of four databases,
each chosen for the query it answers best.
